spans.s: AF0039 आर्त स्वर ārta svara Feeble voice
SK0007 आर्तव ārtava One of the Upadhātus of Rasa Dhātu. Indicative of either Menstrual fluid or Ovum. It is dominant of Agni Mahābhūta.
DG0011 आर्तवजनन ārtavajanana substances stimulating menstrual blood flow or ovulation;
SR0007 आर्तवशोणितम् ārtavaśoṇitam menstrual blood or ovum
SR0006 आर्तवह स्रोताङ्सि ārtavaha srotāṅsi Fallopian or Uterine tubes. Oviduct. / Channels with physiological importance in regulation of menstrual cycles - hypothalamo-pituitary- ovarian axis.
AF0040 आर्तवाघातम् ārtavāghātam Retention of Menstrual blood
